Good day, EYIF Team,

Firstly, thank you for creating this opportunity for young innovators to showcase their ideas and potentially receive support to bring them to life.

I recently submitted an application for the EYIF Grant. After reviewing the eligibility requirements more carefully, I noticed that applicants are required to be between the ages of 18 and 35.

I would like to be transparent and let you know that I am currently 15 years old. Despite my age, I have dedicated the past several months to researching and designing Examinr AI, an AI-powered education platform aimed at helping students prepare for examinations with greater confidence.

I understand the importance of the eligibility criteria, but I would like to respectfully ask if an exception could be considered or if there is any way I may still participate based on the strength of my project and its potential impact.

Thank you for taking the time to read my message. Regardless of the outcome, I truly appreciate the opportunity EYIF provides to young innovators, and I look forward to your response.

Kind regards,
